title: Sup bound from a gradient bound: |ζ| <= M r when tsupport ζ ⊆ B°_r(0)
statement: Let n >= 1, let ζ : R^n → R be differentiable, let r >= 0 with tsupport ζ contained in the open ball B°_r(0), and let M be a real number with ‖∇ζ(x)‖ <= M for every x ∈ R^n (∇ζ = gradient ζ). Then |ζ(y)| <= M r for every y ∈ R^n.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (ζ : Rn n → ℝ) (r M : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → Differentiable ℝ ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 r → (∀ x, ‖gradient ζ x‖ ≤ M) → ∀ y, |ζ y| ≤ M * r
